summary: The finite matching construction is pointwise correct, its two endpoint marginals jointly respect the original mixed-volume capacity, and midpoint pushforward mass is dominated by mixed halfspace mass without losing boundary mass. Same-parity endpoints yield integral-base graph midpoints, so the accepted discrete centerpoint fact applies to the projected midpoint measure; separation and affine convexity place the lifted centerpoint in S. The pullback argument proves the stated uniform bound, and the almost-everywhere symmetry hypothesis gives the corollary with the claimed factor. Boundary, zero-overlap, zero-mass, diagonal, and degenerate pullback cases are all handled.
